name: Space Sailors
desc:
A MASSIVE UPDATE IS UNDERWAY! IN-GAME TRAILER & DETAILS POSTED ON THE GROUP/COMMUNITY PAGE!

Welcome to Space Sailors! A game of a spaceflight along with a phenomenal astronomical experience awaits!

🏆 2021 Bloxy Nominee, an achievement to remember, forever!

This is a simple game where you hop on a rocket, travel to space, visit the ISS, embark on an Artemis mission to the Moon, or go Earth-independent and land on Mars and beyond, fly a plane (or any method of flight) and also go skydiving at the Spaceport Resort!

NOTES:
- Some features will not work well for phones so PC is highly recommended.
- Updates can be slow since I'm the one and only developer in this! Feel free to contribute! More info on the community server.
- For the best experience, have your graphics at 9 or higher.
